attributes.name: contractualTerms
attributes.value: Standard trade account. Monthly ordering with volume discount.

attributes.name: supplyRisk
attributes.value: Low — diverse supplier market. Occasional discontinuation of specialist products.

attributes.name: communityDescription
attributes.value: Dog owners in the local area — breed groups, social walking groups, social media communities.

attributes.name: relationshipToService
attributes.value: Constitutive — the local dog-owning community is the customer base. Breed-specific knowledge flows both ways.

attributes.name: engagementMode
attributes.value: Social media presence, breed group engagement, local dog events, grooming tips and advice sharing.

attributes.name: mutualBenefit
attributes.value: Community gains expert grooming and breed-specific care advice. Paws gains breed knowledge, trust, and word-of-mouth referrals.

attributes.name: communityVoice
attributes.value: Customer reviews, social media feedback, breed-specific grooming preference discussions, seasonal coat care advice requests.

elements.name: pawsParticipation
elements.doc:
Pet owner as informed participant — communicates breed
needs and health history, present during grooming.

attributes.name: participantRole
attributes.value: Informed participant — owner communicates needs and preferences, groomer delivers the service

attributes.name: participationDescription
attributes.value: Owner communicates breed needs, health history, behavioural notes, and grooming preferences at check-in. Owner may be present or nearby during grooming. Post-grooming handover includes condition notes.

attributes.name: informationContribution
attributes.value: Breed details, health conditions, behavioural notes (e.g. anxiety triggers), grooming style preferences, skin sensitivity, previous grooming history.

attributes.name: decisionInvolvement
attributes.value: Consulted — owner expresses preferences, groomer advises on breed-appropriate options and makes professional decisions about safe handling.

attributes.name: selfServiceScope
attributes.value: Online booking, viewing grooming notes, rebooking preferred services.

attributes.name: supportRequired
attributes.value: Clear communication about grooming options, breed-specific care advice, transparent pricing for add-on services.

elements.name: dogGroomer
elements.doc:
Qualified dog groomer — the primary resource.
City & Guilds Level 3 in Dog Grooming or
equivalent. Breed-specific training preferred.

elements.name: groomingEquipment
elements.doc:
Grooming tables, professional clippers, scissor
sets, blade sets, slicker brushes, combs. One
station per groomer.

attributes.name: costProfile
attributes.value: £2,000 initial per station, £50/month maintenance and replacement

elements.name: bathAndDryingEquipment
elements.doc:
Professional dog bath (height-adjustable), high-velocity
dryer, stand dryer. Shared across groomers.

elements.name: groomingConsumables
elements.doc:
Shampoo, conditioner, finishing sprays, ear cleaner,
styptic powder, blade oil, bandanas/bows. Ongoing
variable cost scaling with appointment volume.

elements.name: bookingSystem
elements.doc:
Online booking and appointment management software.
Handles scheduling, reminders, customer records,
and payment processing.

attributes.name: description
attributes.value: Receive a dog, assess condition, perform grooming to breed standard or owner preference, and return the dog in good condition

attributes.name: requiredResources
attributes.value: 1 groomer + grooming station + bath/dryer + consumables + premises + booking system

attributes.name: enabledOfferingsDescription
attributes.value: Full groom, Wash and tidy, Nail trim

elements.name: standardDayCapacity
elements.doc:
Capacity model for a single groomer working a
standard day. Appointment duration varies by
service type and breed, so capacity is expressed
as a range.

attributes.name: assumptions
attributes.value: 8-hour working day, average 75 min per full groom including turnover, 45 min per wash-and-tidy, 15 min per nail trim. Mix of appointment types.

attributes.name: bottleneck
attributes.value: Groomer time — one dog per groomer at a time

elements.name: animalWelfareDuty
elements.doc:
General duty of care under the Animal Welfare Act
2006. Not a specific regulatory framework like COSHH
— rather a general professional obligation to ensure
animals are not caused unnecessary suffering.
This exercises ResourceConstraint with a general
professional governance posture, distinct from Su

attributes.name: limit
attributes.value: All grooming must be performed with due regard for animal welfare. Dogs showing signs of distress, pain, or health issues must have grooming paused or adapted. Owner to be notified of any concerns.

attributes.name: regulatorySourceDescription
attributes.value: Animal Welfare Act 2006 — duty of care to animals under your control

attributes.name: sourceSegment
attributes.value: Individual pet owners and regular customers

attributes.name: costBehaviour
attributes.value: semi-variable — fixed shifts, overtime for busy periods

elements.name: fullGroomEconomics
elements.doc:
Per-appointment economics for a full groom.
Average across breed sizes. Revenue varies by
size band; costs are relatively stable.

attributes.name: breakdownNotes
attributes.value: Labour £16.50 (avg 60 min), consumables £2.50, equipment wear £1.50, booking system £1.50. Rent excluded (fixed cost). Revenue is weighted average across size bands.

elements.name: washAndTidyEconomics
elements.doc:
Per-appointment economics for wash and tidy.
Shorter appointment, lower price, but good margin
due to reduced labour time.

attributes.name: breakdownNotes
attributes.value: Labour £8.25 (avg 30 min), consumables £2.00, equipment wear £1.25, booking system £1.50. Rent excluded.

elements.name: nailTrimEconomics
elements.doc:
Per-appointment economics for nail trim.
Quick, low-cost service. Good margin as a
standalone; excellent as an add-on since the
dog is already on the table.

attributes.name: breakdownNotes
attributes.value: Labour £4.13 (15 min) as standalone. As add-on: marginal cost near zero (dog already present). Consumables negligible.

elements.name: perAppointmentPricing
elements.doc:
Per-appointment pricing with breed/size bands.
Three size categories: small (up to 10kg),
medium (10-25kg), large (25kg+). Double-coated
breeds attract a surcharge.

attributes.name: adjustmentLogic
attributes.value: Full groom: small £35, medium £48, large £65. Wash and tidy: small £20, medium £28, large £40. Nail trim: £10 standalone, £5 add-on. Double-coated breed surcharge +£10.

attributes.name: applicableOfferings
attributes.value: Full groom, Wash and tidy, Nail trim

elements.name: animalWelfareDutyOfCare
elements.doc:
Animal Welfare Act 2006 — duty of care to animals
under your control. Applies to any person responsible
for an animal, including during grooming. Five welfare
needs: suitable environment, suitable diet, ability to
exhibit normal behaviour, housing with or apart from
other animals, protection from pa

attributes.name: title
attributes.value: Animal welfare duty of care during grooming

attributes.name: regulatorySource
attributes.value: Animal Welfare Act 2006 — Section 9 (duty of person responsible for animal to ensure welfare)

attributes.name: complianceDescription
attributes.value: All grooming must be performed with due regard for the animal's welfare. Dogs must not be caused unnecessary suffering. Signs of distress must be recognised and acted upon. Health concerns observed during grooming must be communicated to the owner. Equipment must be maintained in safe working order. The grooming environment must be suitable for dogs.

attributes.name: evidenceRequired
attributes.value: Public liability insurance, incident and observation log, first aid kit inspection records, groomer training and CPD records

elements.name: publicLiabilityInsurance
elements.doc:
Current public liability insurance certificate.
Required for any business handling animals on
premises. Covers injury to animals and third parties.

attributes.name: evidenceDescription
attributes.value: Current public liability insurance policy covering dog grooming services. Must cover injury to animals in care and injury to third parties on premises.

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.value: Annual renewal — certificate held on file

elements.name: incidentAndObservationLog
elements.doc:
Log of any incidents during grooming (nicks, stress
reactions, health concerns observed) and actions
taken. Demonstrates duty of care through transparent
recording and appropriate response.

attributes.name: evidenceDescription
attributes.value: Dated record of any grooming incidents (cuts, abrasions, stress responses), health observations (lumps, skin conditions, parasites), and actions taken (grooming paused, owner notified, vet referral suggested). Includes near-misses.

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.value: Per incident — reviewed weekly by business owner

elements.name: firstAidKitInspection
elements.doc:
Periodic inspection of the animal first aid kit.
Styptic powder, bandages, antiseptic, eye wash,
emergency vet contact details.

attributes.name: evidenceDescription
attributes.value: Dated record of animal first aid kit inspection: styptic powder stock, bandage supply, antiseptic availability, eye wash expiry check, emergency vet contact details current.

elements.name: animalWelfareActReference
elements.doc:
The Animal Welfare Act 2006 — the primary legislative
reference for duty of care obligations.

attributes.name: referenceSource
attributes.value: UK Parliament — Animal Welfare Act 2006, Section 9

attributes.name: referenceNotes
attributes.value: Duty of person responsible for animal to ensure welfare. Five welfare needs. Applies to any person responsible for an animal, including during commercial grooming services.
